Privacy Policy Description: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information in accordance with Telegram requirements.
Privacy Section 1 Content: When using our service, we collect the following information: Telegram ID and username (provided automatically through Telegram WebApp), geolocation data (when permission is granted), access to device microphone (only with your explicit permission and only for making audio calls through our service). We do NOT collect or store phone numbers, contacts from your phonebook, SMS messages, file system data, IMEI or other device identifiers, operating system notifications, or list of installed applications.
Privacy Section 2 Content: We explicitly state that we do NOT obtain or collect access to phone calls, contacts from phonebook, SMS messages, device file system, IMEI / device ID, operating system notifications, or list of installed applications. Our service operates exclusively within Telegram WebApp framework and does not require access to the aforementioned data.
Privacy Section 3 Content: The collected information is used exclusively to provide service functionality: user identification through Telegram ID, displaying username in the interface, enabling audio calls through microphone access (only during active calls), improving connection quality. We do not share your data with third parties and do not use it for advertising or marketing purposes.
Privacy Section 4 Content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. All data is transmitted over secure connections. Microphone access is requested only when necessary and can be revoked by you at any time through browser settings.
Privacy Section 5 Content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time. You can delete your account and all associated data through a special form on the profile page in the application. The "Logout" function ends the current session but does not delete the account. After account deletion, all data is permanently deleted from our servers within 30 days, data recovery is not possible.
Privacy Section 6 Content: We store your data only for the time necessary to provide the service. Upon account deletion, all data is permanently deleted within 30 days. Geolocation data is not stored on servers and is used only at the moment of request.
